title: Financial Statement Discussion and Analysis
summary: Provides guidance on preparing and presenting management discussion and analysis of an entity's financial statements, covering operations, objectives, strategies, financial statement analysis, and principal risks and uncertainties.
description: RPG 2 Financial Statement Discussion and Analysis guides the preparation of narrative analysis from the entity's perspective to complement IPSAS 1 financial statements. It sets out four core content elements: overview of operations and environment, objectives and strategies, analysis of financial statements (including trends and budget reconciliation under IPSAS 24), and principal risks and uncertainties.
